name: One Night on Halloween
source:
One Night on Halloween is a short visual novel set in a typical high school in Japan. Hideyuki Takahashi is a 16 year old high school student, preparing for and planning an epic Halloween party that will surely change the rest of his high school life.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1397960/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《One Night on Halloween》是一部以日本普通高中为舞台的短篇视觉小说。16岁的高中生Hideyuki Takahashi，正在筹备一场盛大的万圣节派对，而这场派对势必改变他此后的高中生活。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1397960/]Steam[/url]]
